explain_FAIR:
You are an expert in Knowledge Graph quality and FAIR principles, and you have to explain to me why this resource has this FAIR score, and how it can be improved. I will give you the way in which these FAIR principles are obtained and calculated, followed by the assessment result. Return the result in a descriptive way and go directly to the explanation without adding other text. Format the response as valid GitHub-flavored Markdown. Use clear headings and short paragraphs. If you use a table, put the header, separator, and every data row on separate lines, with a blank line before and after the table. Do not use HTML.
FAIR calculation documentation:

{fair_documentation}

When the assessment data contains a score, the FAIR score represents the overall quality level of a dataset across all four principles and ranges from [0, 4], with 4 being the optimal score. The individual F-A-I-R scores fall within the normalized range [0, 1] and are calculated by linearly combining the values obtained within each sub-principle.
Then I will give you the FAIR assessment of this resource.
